parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the lighter is a metallic cover that protects the ignition mechanism and flame area. It is made of stainless steel for durability and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover and protect the internal components from dust and accidental ignition, and it also extinguishes the flame when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge to open and close, allowing access to the ignition area.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: The wheel is a small serrated metal component used to generate sparks when rotated against the flint.
parts.Functional_description: It creates friction with the flint to produce sparks that ignite the fuel vapor.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis when flicked by the user’s thumb.

parts.name: Connector (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The connector is a small metallic hinge or pin that links the lid to the base body, allowing rotational movement.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the pivot mechanism for the lid, ensuring smooth opening and closing.
parts.Movement_description: It acts as a rotational joint, allowing the lid to swing open and closed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the lighter, typically made of stainless steel, containing the fuel reservoir and ignition components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fuel, wick, and ignition system, providing structural integrity and a surface for gripping.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the main support structure.
